title: assign_devid rollback unregisters previously-set callback
description: If wc_crypto2dev_assign_devid(ctx) succeeds and wc_crypto2dev_assign_devid_ssl(ssl) is then called and its wolfSSL_SetDevId fails (or RegisterDevice re-registration fails with an error), the failure rollback calls wc_CryptoCb_UnRegisterDevice, which removes the registration that the first call successfully made. ctx still has WOLF_CRYPTO2DEV_DEVID set but no callback is registered. Subsequent TLS operations on ctx silently fall through to software or fail, depending on wolfSSL's no-callback behavior. Severity depends on whether wolfSSL RegisterDevice allows re-registration (overwrites) or rejects it.
